faqs.question: Do you offer same-day delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer same-day and next-day delivery throughout the Houston area, including Sugar Land, Pearland, Missouri City, and surrounding cities. Call us at 832-851-5250 to confirm availability for your area.

faqs.question: What areas do you deliver to?
faqs.answer: We deliver throughout the Greater Houston area. This includes Houston, Sugar Land, Pearland, Missouri City, Stafford, Rosenberg, Richmond, and nearby communities. Contact us for specific delivery availability.

faqs.question: Is there a delivery fee?
faqs.answer: Delivery fees vary depending on your location and the size of your order. Contact us for a specific quote. We often run free delivery promotions — ask us about current offers!

faqs.question: Do you offer financing?
faqs.answer: Yes! We partner with Koalafi, Snap Finance, and Acima to offer flexible financing options with no credit needed. You can apply in-store or ask us about the application process when you call.

faqs.question: What if I have bad credit or no credit?
faqs.answer: No problem! Our financing partners specialize in no-credit-needed and bad-credit financing. Snap Finance and Acima are specifically designed to help customers with limited or poor credit history get approved quickly.

faqs.question: Can I see the furniture before buying?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Visit our showroom at 6951 McHard Rd STE D1, Houston TX 77053. Our hours are Mon–Sat 10am–8pm and Sun 11am–6pm. We have a wide selection on display for you to see and feel in person.

faqs.question: Do you assemble the furniture?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our delivery team will bring your furniture inside and assemble it for you at no extra charge on most orders. Ask us about assembly services when placing your order.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We accept returns within 7 days of delivery on most items, provided they are in original condition and packaging. Custom orders and mattresses are final sale. Contact us at 832-851-5250 for return assistance.

faqs.question: Do you price match?
faqs.answer: We strive to offer the best prices in Houston. If you find the same item at a lower price from a local competitor, contact us and we'll do our best to match it.

faqs.question: How do I request a quote for a specific item?
faqs.answer: You can request a quote by calling us at 832-851-5250, using the quote form on our website, or visiting our showroom. We're happy to help you find exactly what you need within your budget.
